definitions.explanation: The main content stream in social media applications (Twitter/X, Facebook, etc.) showing posts in chronological or algorithmic order.
A visual representation of events in chronological order, used in project management, presentations, or historical contexts.

examples.japanese: タイムライン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れて→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A new post appeared on my timeline.

notes:
USAGE NOTE: In Japanese, タイムライン is primarily used in social media contexts, especially referring to the main feed on platforms like Twitter/X, LINE, and Facebook. The abbreviation TL (ティーエル) is also common in casual online communication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・タイムライン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧ (to appear on one's timeline)
・タイムライン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to refresh the timeline)
・タイムライン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遡|さかのぼ}る→遡る：04003_sakanoboru⟧ (to scroll back through the timeline)
・タイムライン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{荒|あ}らす→荒らす：14057_arasu⟧ (to spam/flood the timeline)

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦フィード→フィード：29756_fiido⟧ (feed) - synonym for timeline in some apps
・⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧ (post)
・⟦リツイート→リツイート：08796_ritsuiito⟧ (retweet)
・⟦いいね→いいね：05865_iine⟧ (like)
・⟦フォロー→フォロー：04730_foroo⟧ (follow)

ABBREVIATION:
・TL (ティーエル) - commonly used on Twitter/X
